title: 人物电影级渲染
prompt: Full-body shot of a [character + location], with a powerful aura of energy around [him/her] and [visual effect], [action or movement] in a dynamic pose. Realistic photography, cinematic lighting, and hyper-detailed rendering.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作电影级人物渲染，实现超写实全身动态姿势与能量特效，适用于游戏角色设计、影视预演等专业场景。
